Welcome to the Universe of Arlandia. This is the biggest world created for Neverwinter Nights because it is expanding itself while you're playing. And there is much more to discover, but for now let us concern about you.

In this Universe, you can play many different races of creatures, including monsters. You can also choose to keep your original race, but if you choose another one, you will get additional bonuses and maluses to your original race.

Check the official website of this server to see the other playable races and their bonuses/maluses.
Are you sure about your choice ?
Here is a list of available playable races. Click on one to have a look at the appearance.
See your new appearance. If you want to play that race, click CONTINUE. Otherwise, click Back or Abort.

Are you sure you want to play another race ? You will have no possibility to change once you've started to play in this world, otherwise than asking a DM for a special favour.

Note : Werecats and werewolfs only get this special appearance by activating their racial bonus.
Now you have to choose the star system you want to start in. Star systems have all unique planets and characteristics.
Click ENTER THE GAME when you are ready to play.
